programme.title: One Dark Night
programme.desc: 1982. Horror. Directed by Tom McLoughlin. Stars Meg Tilly, Melissa Newman & Robin Evans. As part of an initiation into a club called The Sisters, a young girl must spend the night in a mausoleum.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro as she takes a peek at next week's fantastic features.

programme.title: King Kong 2
programme.desc: 1986. Action. Director: John Guillermin. Stars Brian Kerwin, Linda Hamilton & Peter Elliott. Years after his fall from a skyscraper, King Kong is in a coma and in dire need of a blood transfusion.

programme.title: Run for the Sun
programme.desc: 1956. Thriller. Directed by Roy Boulting. Stars Jane Greer, Richard Widmark & Trevor Howard. An author and a journalist find themselves at the mercy of wanted war criminals in the Mexican jungle.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: 1957. Western. Director: Allan Dwan. Stars Scott Brady, Anne Bancroft, Jay C. Flippen. A young lawyer travels to Mission, a small Texas border town, to even the score for the murder of his father.

programme.title: Eddie Carroll & His Orchestra
programme.desc: 1939. Directed by Horace Shepherd - Enjoy 'Harlem', 'Home', 'Taint what you do', 'What do you know about love?' and many more with Eddie Carroll and his Orchestra, sung by Gwen Jones.

programme.title: Beau Geste
programme.desc: Episode Seven. 1982. Stars Benedict Taylor, John Forgeham & Jonathon Morris. A few of the men are on the point of mutiny when the fort comes under repeated attack from the Tuareg.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: 1952. Starring Mark Stevens & Angela Lansbury. During the war of 1812, the U.S. arranges to borrow gold from France. A young Captain must navigate through the British blockade.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout September.

programme.title: Space Patrol
programme.desc: Volcanoes of Venus. 1963. Stars Ronnie Stevens & Murray Kash. Slim is sent to Venus to investigate a mysterious disease which is paralysing the population and is surprised by what he finds.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Sandman Cometh. 1966. Stars Adam West & Michael Rennie. When a policewoman informs Gordon that Catwoman and the Sandman are planning mischief together, Batman and Robin spring into action.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: Knight Errant at Large. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Anne Lawson, David Davies. Richard is recognised while fleeing through Austria and quickly finds himself a prisoner of the tyrannical Lord Rudolf.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Trapped in the Depths. 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. The US Navy are testing a new bathyscaphe when disaster strikes. The Supercar team spring into action to save the trapped crew.

programme.title: BFI: The Salvage Gang
programme.desc: 1958. Drama. Directed by John Krish. Delightful CFF drama. Whilst building a rabbit hutch, a group of children break Dad's saw. Needing to replace it, the children do odd jobs all across London.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Queen Eleanor. 1955. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Queen Eleanor departs from Nottingham castle. The Sheriff arranges to have her entourage ambushed and steal her gold.

programme.title: First Man Into Space
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Robert Day. Stars Marshall Thompson & Marla Landi. A U.S. Navy test pilot rockets himself into space but vanishes. Soon after, a blood thirsty creature appears on Earth.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Open Window. 1959. Stars Michael Higgins, Louise Fletcher & Charles Seel. A temperamental artist has a premonition of a woman's death in a neighbouring building.

programme.title: The Atomic Submarine
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet. Stars Arthur Franz & Dick Foran. A submarine is sent out to investigate a series of naval disasters, but the crew also get caught up in the chaos.

programme.title: Look At Life Thunder in Waiting
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the deadly cargo of the Vulcan Bomber and how it is a crucial part of Britain's force to deter attacks on the country.

programme.title: The Black Widow (1951)
programme.desc: 1951. Thriller. Directed by Vernon Sewell. Stars Christine Norden, Robert Ayres & Jennifer Jayne. A man suffering from amnesia learns that his scheming wife and her lover are plotting his demise.

programme.title: Blind Corner
programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars William Sylvester, Barbara Shelley & Elizabeth Shepherd. The wife of a blind composer plots to murder her husband after he learns of her affair.

programme.title: Look At Life Under the Hammer
programme.desc: 1961. A look at the world of auctions and auctioneers, also with a glimpse at the various items sold and the different types of people drawn to the sale rooms.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Cactus. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Sheila Burrell. After one of his men is injured by an apartment house, Maigret takes up temporary residence so he can investigate undercover.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. Clash By Night. Creator: John Finch. Stars John McKelvey & Keith Drinkel. A still-blind Phillip encounters an old enemy who once shot one of his comrades in the Spanish Civil War. (S2, E16)

programme.title: The First of the Few
programme.desc: 1942. War. Directed by and stars Leslie Howard. Features David Niven & Rosamund John. Aviation pioneer R.J. Mitchell struggles to develop the Spitfire fighter plane before war with Germany begins.

programme.title: Body Double
programme.desc: 1984. Thriller. Directed by Brian De Palma. Stars Craig Wasson & Melanie Griffith. A struggling actor's obsession with spying on a neighbour gets him caught up in a drastic series of events.

programme.title: Let's Spend the Night Together
programme.desc: 1982. Documentary. Directed by Hal Ashby. Stars Mick Jagger, Keith Richards & Charlie Watts. Relive the concerts of the Rolling Stones on their American tour in New Jersey and Arizona in 1981.

programme.title: You Will Remember
programme.desc: 1941. Musical drama. Directed by Jack Raymond. Stars: Robert Morley, Emlyn Williams, Dorothy Hyson. Based on the life of the English composer Leslie Stuart, famous in the British music halls.

programme.title: Look At Life The Black Arrows
